name: Polyhedron Sorting with Fine-Tuning
aliases: Hidden surface removal for volume primitives
definition: A three-stage sorting algorithm for rendering convex polyhedra (volume primitives) in correct depth order, handling non-planar faces and cycles.
summary: Polyhedron Sorting with Fine-Tuning is a three-stage algorithm that renders convex volume primitives in correct back-to-front order by using plane separation and edge intersection tests to resolve rendering cycles that simple Z-depth sorting cannot handle.
